_doc: Hyperkuy catalog: the single source of truth for every design. Fields are documented in docs/SCHEMA.md. Edit here, then run `node tools/check.mjs` and `node tools/gallery.mjs`.

how-ai-works.name: How AI Works
how-ai-works.about: Abstract concepts made visible: tokens, attention, embeddings, temperature, context window, hallucination.
how-ai-works.frame: Series label + episode number top-left; closing 'next: <concept>'; one grid row of covers = 3 episodes.

ai-in-numbers.name: AI in Numbers
ai-in-numbers.about: One surprising number per video with an everyday comparison.
ai-in-numbers.frame: Giant number in the hook; source + date always on screen.

ai-news.name: AI News This Week
ai-news.about: Five news items per week: model releases, new features, regulation.
ai-news.frame: 'This week' ribbon + date; one item = one card.

ai-tools.name: AI Tools & One Prompt
ai-tools.about: Tool reviews, step-by-step tutorials, 'one prompt, done' demos.
ai-tools.frame: A mock app UI as the stage; two-voice dialogue.

styles.name: Dusk Mode
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A dark AI chat app that brightens as a one-prompt result is built and edited on screen.
styles.signature: Chat bubbles type in, the generated artifact assembles, then the scene flips from dark to light.

styles.name: Lockscreen Story
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Starts on a phone lock screen full of relatable notifications, then turns into a step-by-step result.
styles.signature: Notifications stack in, then a circle wipe opens onto a cream page where cards fill in step by step.

styles.name: Design Canvas
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: The whole explainer lives inside a design tool: selections, cursors, dotted connectors.
styles.signature: Cursor clicks a word and an 8-handle selection box snaps around it; lines rise from a text mask.

styles.name: Caution Tape Pop
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Loud news-style poster: caution tape running top and bottom, giant tight headline, stickers.
styles.signature: Caution tape scrolls, the headline stacks in word by word, stickers drop into place.

styles.name: Frosted Orbs
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Calm launch-film look: soft blurred colour orbs behind frosted glass cards.
styles.signature: Text rises out of blur onto a glass card while the orb behind it changes colour per scene.

styles.name: Sticker Collage
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Pastel design board mixing a selection-boxed headline with 3D icon stickers and price cards.
styles.signature: Headline gets a selection box, 3D icons float in as accents, numbered steps appear in serif.

styles.name: Prompt Classroom
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A friendly prompt lesson: character chips, a chat box being filled, before/after cards.
styles.signature: The prompt box fills label by label (CONTEXT, GOAL…) and the bad vs good answer cards swap.

styles.name: Repo Cards
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Dark GitHub-style repo cards with stars, licence and activity, ranked #1, #2, #3.
styles.signature: Rank number slams in, the repo card slides up, contribution squares light up.

styles.name: Electric Sunburst
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Electric-blue poster with tall condensed type and engraved sunburst lines.
styles.signature: Sunburst lines draw outward, the condensed title stacks up, a cycle diagram rotates into place.

styles.name: Ember Docs
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Warm charcoal docs page: cream serif headline with an ember-orange italic, terminal boxes.
styles.signature: Terminal command types out and a checkmark line answers it.

styles.name: Midnight Chat
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Pure-black chat transcript where each slide is a question bubble followed by its answer.
styles.signature: Question bubble pops in on the right, the answer streams in below with a comparison box.

styles.name: Biennale Yellow
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Exhibition catalogue on warm paper with a yellow haze and thin navy serif.
styles.signature: Catalogue rows slide onto the yellow band one by one.

styles.name: Blockframe
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Sharp neo-brutalist cards: thick black borders, hard offset shadows, slight tilts.
styles.signature: Cards drop in tilted and snap their hard shadow under them.

styles.name: Bold Poster
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Vintage sports-magazine poster: classical serif, tomato red, a ruled stats table.
styles.signature: The red headline slams in at an angle, stats fill the table row by row.

styles.name: Broadside
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Fire-orange broadside with massive flat type and black slabs.
styles.signature: Black slabs wipe in from the left, values punch in large.

styles.name: Capsule
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: High-contrast Bodoni with candy-coloured capsule pills.
styles.signature: Pills float in and settle; the highlight word drops into its pill. (Bodoni '1' reads like 'I'.)

styles.name: Cobalt Grid
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Graph paper with electric cobalt riso printing and an indexed table.
styles.signature: Index rows print in two-colour riso style, the highlight block fills cobalt.

styles.name: Cartesian
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Quiet museum catalogue: specimen cards, hairlines, compass geometry.
styles.signature: Compass circles draw themselves, specimen cards fade up with roman numerals.

styles.name: Code Editorial
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Editorial page in Garamond with a navy YAML code window and footnoted sources.
styles.signature: The code window types the data line by line; a footnote marker links to the source.

styles.name: Terminal Noir
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A terminal window where each item is a line of command output.
styles.signature: Command types out, output lines print with dotted leaders, the cursor blinks on the summary.

styles.name: Marquee Select
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Dark headline panel with a design-tool selection box on the key word and stat chips.
styles.signature: Cursor glides to the keyword, the selection box and handles snap on, chips light up.

styles.name: Leaderboard
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A league standings table: position, name, value and a bar per row, plus a winner card.
styles.signature: Rows slot into rank order and bars grow (use real proportional values in videos).

styles.name: IDE Nocturne
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A night-mode code editor: tabs, line numbers, minimap; items become an object literal.
styles.signature: The title line gets selected, then the object literal types out key by key.

styles.name: Drafting Light
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Engineering drawing sheet on millimetre grid: title block, crop marks, spec card, design-tool selection with dotted connectors.
styles.signature: Selection box lands on the keyword, the connector draws itself to the spec card, rows fill in.

styles.name: Drafting Dark
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: The dark twin of Drafting Light: deep blue-charcoal sheet, glassy spec card, terminal accents.
styles.signature: Same choreography as Drafting Light, with a terminal cursor on the meta line.

styles.name: Split-Flap Board
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A station split-flap departure board; news, numbers and status flip in line by line.
styles.signature: Cells flip left to right row by row with a soft clack per row; only changed cells re-flip.

styles.name: Transit Map
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A Beck-style transit diagram: one AI concept = one line, each step = a station.
styles.signature: The line draws itself from the left, pauses at each station, a train dot travels along it.

styles.name: Nutrition Label
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A 'Nutrition Facts' label reading out what a model, prompt or feature contains.
styles.signature: Heavy rules draw left to right by hierarchy, then each value types or counts up.

styles.name: Instrument Panel
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A synth/instrument faceplate where AI parameters (temperature, top-p, context) are knobs and LCDs.
styles.signature: Knobs turn to their values one by one, LCD digits scramble then lock, an LED blinks once.

styles.name: Data Annotation
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: Data-journalism chart: one clean graphic, one point that matters, one editorial note pointing at it.
styles.signature: Bars grow left to right, the leader line draws to the point, the point pulses once.

styles.name: Architect's Model
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A white cardboard architect's study model on a grey site board; block height = magnitude.
styles.signature: Each block extrudes up from its footprint in turn, shadows lengthen, a flag pin drops.

styles.name: Rice Parcel
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A folded rice parcel as the context window: it only holds so much; each fold opened = one part of the context.
styles.signature: The rubber band stretches and snaps, the four folds open one by one.

styles.name: Card Catalog
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A library card catalogue as RAG/embeddings: cards stored near their neighbours.
styles.signature: A drawer slides out toward the viewer and the cards inside fan forward.

styles.name: Postage Stamps
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A sheet of stamps: one stamp = one token with a face value; the sheet = the context window.
styles.signature: A postmark slams onto the highlighted stamp with a little ink bleed.

styles.name: Chess Notation
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: Chess diagram with move notation as chain-of-thought: thinking several moves ahead.
styles.signature: A piece glides to its square (no bounce), then the move is written in notation.

styles.name: Piano Roll
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A player-piano roll: the next hole not yet visible = the next token.
styles.signature: The paper scrolls up at a steady pace; holes that reach the reader bar light up.

styles.name: Rock Strata
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: Rock layers as the stages of building a model: thick pre-training at the bottom, thin fine-tuning on top.
styles.signature: Layers settle from bottom to top, then a core drill descends through them.

styles.name: Weather Chart
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A synoptic weather chart: AI output is a probability forecast, not certainty.
styles.signature: Isobars draw outward from the low-pressure centre as concentric contours.

styles.name: Bento Box
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A bento box as structured output / JSON: each compartment = a field.
styles.signature: The lid slides off, compartments fill one by one.

styles.name: Nautical Night
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A night nautical chart: soundings = how confident the model is; shallows = hallucination risk.
styles.signature: Depth soundings print outward from the ship like a sonar sweep.

styles.name: Tree Rings
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: Tree rings as history: one ring per year or model release; thick = boom year, thin = AI winter.
styles.signature: Rings grow outward from the pith one by one, ring thickness = value.

styles.name: Dartboard
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: Accuracy vs precision vs hallucination: tight but off-centre = consistent but wrong.
styles.signature: Darts land one by one with a short thunk.

styles.name: Chromatography Strip
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A chromatography strip separating one mixture (prompt, dataset, trend) into its components.
styles.signature: The solvent line creeps up slowly and coloured bands separate as it passes.

styles.name: Fingerpost
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A signpost with arms pointing to options: routing a prompt to a model, tool or plan; distance = cost.
styles.signature: Arms attach one by one and swing to their direction.

styles.name: Woodcut Print
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: Carved wooden type as model weights fixed in training; each print pull = one inference.
styles.signature: Letters first show mirrored as wooden blocks, then the paper lowers and lifts to reveal the print.

styles.name: Loom Weave
styles.author: fable
styles.metaphor: A loom as attention: each token = a warp thread; each pass of the weft touches every thread.
styles.signature: The shuttle runs left to right and back, weaving one row per pass.

styles.name: Contact Sheet
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A photographer's contact sheet: film strips, edge printing, red grease-pencil picks. Metaphor: the AI picks one candidate out of many.
styles.signature: A loupe scans frame by frame, stops on the chosen one, and a red grease-pencil loop draws around it.

styles.name: Engraved Score
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: Engraved sheet music with staves and lyrics. Metaphor: predicting the next note = predicting the next token.
styles.signature: A playhead sweeps the staff; in the ghost bar three candidate notes flicker and the blue one locks in.

styles.name: Assembly Manual
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A flat-pack assembly manual in black line art. Metaphor: how AI works, assembled part by part.
styles.signature: Parts slide along dashed arrows into their holes and get ticked off in the parts box.

styles.name: Live Spreadsheet
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A spreadsheet with a formula bar, active cell and in-cell data bars. Metaphor: AI numbers and costs computed cell by cell.
styles.signature: The formula types into the bar, Enter, cells fill and the data bars grow row by row.

styles.name: Topo Trail
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A topographic hiking map whose orange trail is a true steepest descent. Metaphor: training = walking downhill to the lowest point.
styles.signature: The trail draws itself downhill, a hiker dot walks it, labels appear as they are passed, the lake fills.

styles.name: Periodic Elements
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A navy periodic table where every AI term is an element. Metaphor: build a vocabulary of AI 'elements'.
styles.signature: The table fills row by row, item tiles light up by atomic number, the key element lifts into a detail card.

styles.name: E-Reader Lookup
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: An e-ink reader page: long-press a word, a dictionary popover explains it. Metaphor: tap an AI term, get its meaning.
styles.signature: The keyword gets a selection with teardrop handles, the popover rises with an e-ink flash, entries appear.

styles.name: Sewing Pattern
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A tissue sewing pattern on a slate cutting mat. Metaphor: tokenisation = cutting a pattern into pieces.
styles.signature: Scissors follow the cut line, each piece separates and shifts a little, its count appears.

styles.name: Bubble Test
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A machine-graded multiple-choice answer sheet with 2B pencil bubbles. Metaphor: the AI chooses an answer by likelihood.
styles.signature: Pencil fills bubbles row by row; one row is erased and re-filled; a score is written in the margin.

styles.name: Lab Report
styles.author: opus
styles.metaphor: A clinical lab report with reference ranges and H/L flags. Metaphor: read AI numbers against a normal range. Ranges are illustrative.
styles.signature: Rows print one by one, a marker slides along each range bar, out-of-range rows tint and get an 'H'.

styles.name: Letterpress Desk
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: Metal type blocks and a press compose the text a little at a time.
styles.signature: Concept only - animate as type blocks dropping into the chase line by line.

styles.name: Ticket Raffle
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: A clear raffle box of tickets; one ticket is drawn to continue the sentence.
styles.signature: Concept only - a hand draws one ticket; the unequal pile shows some words are likelier.

styles.name: Receipt Printer
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: A receipt printer printing the answer bit by bit, like the AI building a reply.
styles.signature: Paper feeds out line by line as each part of the answer is printed (full 56 s video exists).
styles.note: A finished 56 s video exists for this concept (not included in the repo).

styles.name: Next Stitch
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: Fabric, thread and tailor's chalk: each new stitch continues the previous ones.
styles.signature: Concept only - the needle makes the next stitch along a chalk line.

styles.name: Accordion Book
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: A folding accordion book with tabs that unfold the explanation page by page.
styles.signature: Concept only - panels unfold one at a time.

styles.name: Tile Library
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: A ceramic tile sample library where each tile is a filed piece of knowledge.
styles.signature: Concept only - sample tiles slide out of the rack.

styles.name: Measuring Glass
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: Graduated glasses filled to different levels: how likely each next word is.
styles.signature: Concept only - liquid levels rise to their marks.

styles.name: Marble Gates
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: One brass marble, many gates: the path it takes is the answer being chosen.
styles.signature: Concept only - the marble rolls and gates flip as it passes.

styles.name: Open Kitchen
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: An open kitchen with order tickets and covered plates: the reply is cooked step by step.
styles.signature: Concept only - tickets clip onto the rail, cloches lift.

styles.name: Baggage Belt
styles.author: astra
styles.metaphor: A baggage conveyor with diverters routing sentence pieces to the right place.
styles.signature: Concept only - suitcases ride the belt and diverters swing.
